semantics.ranges: Inclusive [min, max] integer levels. These bands are illustrative, not a change to the live game progression curve.
semantics.recommendation: Recommended player levels are guidance, not an entry lock. Explicit tile entryRequirements control locks.
semantics.encounters: Choose only enemy types overlapping encounterLevelRange; roll the enemy level from that intersection. Area levels remain fixed rather than matching player level.
semantics.rewards: Roll a reward level from rewardLevelRange, then filter rewards by dropLevelRange. Reward level is drop eligibility, not gear equip level or enemy level.
